goal: Build the shared virtual filesystem and the four foundational utility apps (Finder, Terminal, Calculator, Notes), all running inside the Phase 1 shell and persisting via the shared hook.
summary:
Phase 2 (Virtual FS + Core Utility Apps) complete. Built the shared virtual filesystem and four foundational utility apps, all running inside the Phase 1 shell and persisting via localStorage.

Deliverables (5 steps):
1. VFS store (src/store/vfs.ts) — flat-tree model keyed by id (root='root'), CRUD (createNode/deleteNode/renameNode/moveNode/updateContent), path resolution (resolvePath/pathOf), setCwd, reseed, persistence via readPersistent/writePersistent. 29 unit tests (vfs.test.ts) covering seed/path/create/delete/rename/move/content/cwd/helpers/persistence.
2. Finder (src/apps/Finder.tsx + src/store/intent.ts) — sidebar favorites (Desktop/Documents/Downloads/Pictures/Projects), browser view with back/forward navigation history, double-click folder navigates / double-click file dispatches to owning app (text/markdown→Notes) via a cross-app intent store, New Folder + Delete + Rename (inline) mutating the VFS. 10 e2e (finder.spec.ts).
3. Terminal (src/apps/Terminal.tsx) — shell over the VFS: ls/cd/pwd/cat/mkdir/touch/echo(>redirect)/clear/help, live prompt from cwd, command history (Up/Down), per-instance cwd. 15 e2e (terminal.spec.ts).
4. Calculator (src/lib/calc-engine.ts + src/apps/Calculator.tsx) — shunting-yard expression engine (no eval) with correct precedence/chaining/parens/unary-minus, Tahoe button grid, keyboard input. 14 unit tests (calc-engine.test.ts) + 13 e2e (calculator.spec.ts).
5. Notes (src/apps/Notes.tsx) — note list + editor with autosave to localStorage via usePersistentState, search filter, create/edit/delete, and cross-app file-open consumption (Finder→Notes import). 7 e2e (notes.spec.ts).

Final verification: lint 0 errors, build ✓, 58/58 unit tests (5 files), 88/88 e2e tests (10 spec files) across finder/terminal/calculator/notes/shell/window-manager/menubar/spotlight/control-center/appearance. No regressions. test-results cleaned.
stepSummaries:

  3. Build Terminal: command parser over the VFS (ls, cd, pwd, cat, mkdir, touch, echo, clear, help), prompt, command history. [verified]
  4. Build Calculator: basic arithmetic with correct chaining/precedence, keyboard input, Tahoe-styled button grid. [verified]
  5. Build Notes: note list + editor, create/edit/delete/search, autosave to localStorage. [verified]
